Insufficient mana ends the attack bonus and mana drain, but the shield remains. Shield break ends all linked effects. The shield lasts up to 15 seconds, or 18 seconds at skill level 10. The cooldown decreases from 120 seconds at skill level 1 to 90 seconds at skill level 10.
